entries.002eaf3b23817247: This business melts steel in electric arc furnaces using iron scrap as the main raw material, and manufactures and sells steel products such as H-beams and hot coils. There are no consolidated subsidiaries; the business is conducted by the company alone and constitutes a single steel segment. Production and sales are carried out at four domestic plants (Tahara, Okayama, Kyushu and Utsunomiya) and the head office, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥268,095 million.
entries.3cf47663f1ea5385: Finished steel products such as H-beams, hot coils (hot-rolled wide steel strip), steel plates, channel steel, deformed bars, steel sheet piles and steel pipes. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥260,360 million, accounting for the bulk of revenue.
